actual_dose_expectation: Inherited dose is unchanged from R15_V3_COMPATIBLE: max_atom_step_A 0.15, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0, native_rms_ratio 0.66, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, constant schedule with schedule_normalization 1.0. Parent measured response gives injected_rms_A_mean about 0.02996 A per active step, actual_cumulative_step_rms_A about 1.20 A over the window, and actual_max_step_rms_A about 0.0309 A, with atom_clip_fraction 0.0 and cumulative_clip_fraction 0.0; the same order of requested displacement is expected here, now applied to slots 4/14/15. Cumulative dose is the sum of per-step RMS, not endpoint displacement. Expected direction is the ancestor-path direction for the support (slot 4 toward +y/+z, slot 14 toward +y/+z), with the [15,4,14] angle held within tolerance; the parent's target_error_mean is policy-relative and is not a fixed-space physical velocity.
derivative_path: Gradients are taken only through the real model coordinates z_h of the current call, on the 3 matched slots; the assignment pi is computed with no gradient (detached), so no derivative flows through the element/logit matching cost and no logits or discrete transition rates are edited. Element, formal-charge and adjacency information are read from the existing generation head as terminal observations only; charge_weight = 0.0 and typed_weight = 0.0, so no typed channel contributes to the update. affinity_head_gradient = false and no per-step affinity inference is added; the affinity head is not differentiated. The model VJP is valid for the current invocation only and is not a derivative over all future stochastic generations. Because routing is single and sensing is detached, no state-dependent mixture weight is differentiated; only the conditional single-mode coordinate gradient is claimed, not an exact derivative of a mixed potential.
design_grounds: Analyst G000 binds a 3-slot local support (slots 4/14/15; terminal elements C/C/N, slot 15 donor N, 4 and 14 aromatic C) whose actual-ancestor path converges monotonically toward the same-forward teacher endpoint over t in [0,0.5] (F_b011_s030__v3_interface15/ancestor). The only executable change permitted by the registry is the mode_specs swap in A000: atom_slots [4,14,15], orientation_triplets [[15,4,14]], pocket_sites VAL53:CG1 / MET163:CE / HIS160:CE1 / HIS160:NE2, region_id F_b011_s030__v3_interface15, template F_b011_s030_native. All other program fields (clock_policy fixed, teacher_time 0.5, type_target predicted, window [0.1,0.5], dose, schedule, routing single, sensing detached, affinity_head_gradient false, coordinate_updates_only true, smc false) are inherited unchanged from R15_V3_COMPATIBLE, so the parent_program_id and its measured response remain the correct comparison baseline. G000 is preferred over G001 because interface16 selection_trend shows focal and background_mean nearly coincident after t>=0.1 with expected_selection_shift ~1e-4 to 1e-3 versus native_shift ~1e-2, and interface16 chemical_context has no orientation triplet; interface15 therefore carries the more discriminative local support. Chemical labels are terminal observations only: site_distance_matrix_A places slot 15 about 4.03 A from HIS160:NE2 and 4.39 A from HIS160:CE1, and conditional_layout_evidence reports n_identifiable_interactions = 0, so no H-bond or interaction energy is claimed. Value is judged on the qualified-pIC50 tail against the parent baseline (best_qualified_pic50 8.590141296386719, mean_all_pic50 7.71079755783081, n_above_target 0), not on mean alone, consistent with source/prior_campaign and source/limits.
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, under the fixed clock, the 3-slot predictive_bridge_to_learning_end error does not decrease over the control window, or the [15,4,14] angle degrades beyond tolerance, or the terminal support no longer holds C/C/N with slot 15 in donor orientation. The value part is falsified if the local geometry improves but the terminal qualified-pIC50 tail shows no improvement over the parent baseline (best_qualified_pic50 8.590141296386719, mean_all_pic50 7.71079755783081, n_above_target 0), i.e. formation/retention of this local support is separated from affinity benefit. Interface errors are recorded separately from scientific negative results; numerically identical configurations reuse existing results rather than introducing new design.
operative_terms: Single local pointwise term over the 3-slot support with the parent's pseudo-Huber reward and detached assignment: pi = argmin over slot assignment of sum_j [ ||z_h[pi_j] - q_j||^2 - c log softmax(l_theta)[pi_j, e_j] ] with c = 0.5 (assignment_element_cost), computed in the no-gradient branch; then R = -(1/K) sum_j delta^2 ( sqrt(1 + ||z_h[pi_j] - q_j||^2 / delta^2) - 1 ) with K = 3 (support size), delta = pointcloud_delta_A = 1.0 A, native_rms_ratio = 0.66, field_sigma_A = 1.5, target_band_A = 0.34907500557366816, switch_margin_A = 0.15, mode_memory_t = 0.05. Orientation triplet [15,4,14] is carried as the declared direction relation of the support; it is not an added energy term. Clock is fixed with teacher_time = 0.5 and observable predictive_bridge_to_learning_end against teacher actual_ancestor_at_learning_end; the two representations (actual current world A and same-forward teacher predicted endpoint world A) are not interchanged. Window [0.1,0.5], steps 100, expected_active_steps 10..49, dose_schedule constant, schedule_normalization 1.0, advantage_cap 20.0, density_scale_floor [0.03,0.1,0.1,0.1], typed_weight 0.0, charge_weight 0.0, routing single, sensing detached, scope local, operator pointwise, coordinate_updates_only true, affinity_head_gradient false, smc false, native_options unchanged (coord_noise_level 0.2, cat_noise_level 1.0, cat_noise_euler_guard false, use_sde_simulation true, final_corr_pred true).
